title: C4 Scoped file-only priming endpoint with auto-prime
description: POST /api/newsroom/curation/priming {query,variables}->{data}, reusing web_api priming types on a publication-scoped PrimingService over S3ConsoleStorage; refuse other publications' list/classifiers/draft ids before any read; transform -> 'no hosted transformer'; idempotent accept; slice-1 size cap ~1 MB with clean failure; after accept the lab applies the examples (auto-prime) so suggestions use them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: POST /api/newsroom/curation/priming (GraphQL subset of the priming surface, introspection off, one operation). Publication-scoped PrimingService over S3ConsoleStorage: namespaced draft ids, one list and classifier set, foreign list/classifiers/draft id refused before storage reads, transform -> 400 no_hosted_transformer, ~1 MB import cap and journal budget -> 413 with nothing saved, accept idempotent. Auto-prime: accept then applies the examples via PublicationCommandRuntime priming branch (BearerActor, no model); spec accepting_applies_the_examples_so_the_next_decision_carries_them proves the next decision's model request carries the example. firewall_overlap refused before accept; auto_prime_failed retry heals.
